title: Rich Swann vs. Eric Young: retirement threat to redemption
summary: Eric Young attacks Rich Swann’s injured leg and appears to end his career. Swann returns to turn that apparent farewell into a world-championship victory over the man who tried to stop him.

chapters.title: Young attacks an apparent farewell
chapters.result: Swann announces retirement, then Young attacks him again.
chapters.context: The on-screen retirement announcement follows the damage inflicted at Slammiversary. Young refuses to let even the farewell pass peacefully, deepening Swann’s reason to return.

chapters.title: Swann completes the comeback
chapters.result: Rich Swann defeats Eric Young to win the Impact world title.
chapters.context: The challenger survives Young’s attack on his vulnerability and wins the main event, transforming the threatened end of his career into its biggest championship achievement.
